facts.fact: CAMIX, the Cameroon internet exchange, states that since 1 July 2026 its third point of presence operates inside the ST-DIGITAL data center in Douala, in a carrier-hotel environment hosting interconnection for operators, ISPs and hosting providers (INK and ST-DIGITAL already connected).
